documentation.what: Layout of the CI-generated mixed source verification data (archive/data/archive2-source-verification/mixed-v1/) that archive/tools/build-archive2-catalog.mjs emits.
documentation.default: v1: readable by every deployed archive2-canonical.js, including the hand-deployed Worker (apmath/worker-backup). Student pages and the Worker both keep working without any Worker redeploy.
documentation.v2: Compact rows, about 64 MB smaller in the Pages package. archive2-canonical.js in this repository reads both layouts; a Worker deployed before the v2 reader existed answers 503 for mixed worksheet validation against v2 data.
howToEnableV2: 1. Redeploy the Worker from a main that contains the v2 reader (archive/archive2-canonical.js decodeMixedRows).
2. Change emitSchema to "v2" in this file and commit it to main.
3. The next Archive Pages Release run regenerates the mixed data as v2, re-registers and deploys it. tests/archive2-mixed-verification-compact.test.mjs verifies both layouts.
documentation.rollback: Set emitSchema back to "v1"; the next release regenerates the data in the v1 layout.
